'use client'
/**
 * components/CrawlPanel/CrawlPanel.jsx
 *
 * App Map crawler controls and live progress display.
 *
 * What it does
 * ─────────────
 * 1. Shows the date/time and summary of the last completed crawl (if any).
 * 2. Lets the user start a new crawl, optionally providing credentials for
 *    applications that are behind a login wall.
 * 3. Streams live crawl progress via SSE — each page discovered appears as a
 *    log line in real time.
 * 4. Shows the final summary once the crawl completes.
 *
 * Props
 * ─────
 * applicationId {number}  — the applications.id to crawl
 * baseUrl       {string}  — shown in the UI so the user knows what will be crawled
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useSSE } from '../../hooks/useSSE'
import { getLatestAppMap } from '../../lib/api'
import styles from './CrawlPanel.module.css'

export default function CrawlPanel({ applicationId, baseUrl }) {
  const [status, setStatus]         = useState('idle')   // idle | running | complete | error
  const [messages, setMessages]     = useState([])
  const [result, setResult]         = useState(null)     // {map_id, page_count, element_count}
  const [lastMap, setLastMap]       = useState(null)     // last completed map summary
  const [showCreds, setShowCreds]   = useState(false)
  const [username, setUsername]     = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword]     = useState('')
  const [maxPages, setMaxPages]     = useState(30)

  const { startStream, cancel } = useSSE()

  // Load the latest map summary when the panel first mounts.
  useEffect(() => {
    getLatestAppMap(applicationId)
      .then(setLastMap)
      .catch(() => setLastMap(null))   // 404 = no crawl yet, that's fine
  }, [applicationId])

  function handleEvent(payload) {
    if (payload.type === 'status') {
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, payload.data.message])
    } else if (payload.type === 'page') {
      const { url, title, element_count, page_number } = payload.data
      setMessages(prev => [
        ...prev,
        `Page ${page_number}: ${title || url} — ${element_count} elements`,
      ])
    }
  }

  function handleDone(data) {
    if (data?.error) {
      setStatus('error')
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, `❌ Error: ${data.error}`])
    } else {
      setStatus('complete')
      setResult(data)
      // Refresh the last-map summary with the new crawl
      getLatestAppMap(applicationId).then(setLastMap).catch(() => {})
    }
  }

  async function handleStartCrawl() {
    setStatus('running')
    setMessages([`Starting crawl of ${baseUrl || 'application'}…`])
    setResult(null)

    // useSSE.startStream POSTs FormData — consistent with all other SSE endpoints.
    const formData = new FormData()
    formData.append('max_pages', String(maxPages))
    if (showCreds && username) formData.append('username', username)
    if (showCreds && password) formData.append('password', password)

    await startStream(
      `/v1/applications/${applicationId}/crawl`,
      formData,
      handleEvent,
      handleDone,
    )
  }

  function handleCancel() {
    cancel()
    setStatus('idle')
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, 'Crawl cancelled.'])
  }

  const isRunning = status === 'running'

  return (
    <div className={styles.panel}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <div className={styles.headerLeft}>
          <span className={styles.icon} aria-hidden="true">🗺</span>
          <div>
            <h3 className={styles.title}>App Map</h3>
            <p className={styles.subtitle}>
              Crawl all pages to build a persistent element map used by surveys and healing.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {lastMap && status === 'idle' && (
          <div className={styles.lastCrawl}>
            <span className={styles.lastCrawlLabel}>Last crawl</span>
            <span className={styles.lastCrawlMeta}>
              {new Date(lastMap.crawled_at).toLocaleString()} ·{' '}
              {lastMap.page_count} pages · {lastMap.element_count} elements
              {lastMap.was_authenticated && ' · 🔐 authenticated'}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Credential toggle */}
      {status === 'idle' && (
        <div className={styles.controls}>
          <label className={styles.credToggle}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={showCreds}
              onChange={e => setShowCreds(e.target.checked)}
            />
            Crawl with authentication
          </label>

          {showCreds && (
            <div className={styles.creds}>
              <input
                className={styles.input}
                type="text"
                placeholder="Username / email"
                value={username}
                onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                autoComplete="username"
              />
              <input
                className={styles.input}
                type="password"
                placeholder="Password"
                value={password}
                onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                autoComplete="current-password"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div className={styles.pagesRow}>
            <label className={styles.pagesLabel} htmlFor="maxPages">Max pages</label>
            <input
              id="maxPages"
              className={styles.inputSmall}
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={100}
              value={maxPages}
              onChange={e => setMaxPages(Number(e.target.value) || 30)}
            />
          </div>

          <button className={styles.startBtn} onClick={handleStartCrawl}>
            Start Crawl
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Progress log */}
      {(isRunning || status === 'complete' || status === 'error') && (
        <div className={styles.log} role="log" aria-live="polite">
          {messages.map((msg, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={styles.logLine}>
              <span className={styles.logIdx}>{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
              <span className={styles.logMsg}>{msg}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Running controls */}
      {isRunning && (
        <div className={styles.runningBar}>
          <span className={styles.spinner} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>Crawling…</span>
          <button className={styles.cancelBtn} onClick={handleCancel}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Completion summary */}
      {status === 'complete' && result && (
        <div className={styles.summary}>
          <span className={styles.summaryOk}>✓</span>
          <span>
            Crawl complete — <strong>{result.page_count}</strong> pages,{' '}
            <strong>{result.element_count}</strong> elements (map #{result.map_id})
          </span>
          <button
            className={styles.restartBtn}
            onClick={() => { setStatus('idle'); setMessages([]); setResult(null) }}
          >
            Crawl again
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error + restart */}
      {status === 'error' && (
        <div className={styles.errorBar}>
          <button
            className={styles.restartBtn}
            onClick={() => { setStatus('idle'); setMessages([]); setResult(null) }}
          >
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * components/Markdown/Markdown.jsx
 *
 * A deliberately small markdown renderer, shared by the help article reader
 * and the chat panel.
 *
 * It exists because both places need the same thing and neither should carry
 * a markdown library. The articles are authored in this repository and
 * reviewed in a diff; the chat text comes from a model that was told to write
 * plain prose and lists. Between them they use headings, bullets, numbered
 * steps, bold, and inline code — that is the whole grammar, and it is about
 * sixty lines.
 *
 * The chat panel matters more than it looks. Rendering a model's reply as raw
 * text turns "1. **Create the suite** — Open Applications" into a wall with
 * literal asterisks and no line breaks, because HTML collapses newlines. The
 * answer can be correct and still unreadable, which is indistinguishable from
 * being wrong.
 *
 * Nothing here uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Text is rendered as React nodes,
 * so neither an article nor a model reply can inject markup.
 */

import { useMemo } from 'react'

export default function Markdown({ text, className }) {
  const blocks = useMemo(() => parseMarkdown(text || ''), [text])
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {blocks.map((b, i) => {
        if (b.type === 'h2') return <h2 key={i}>{inline(b.text)}</h2>
        if (b.type === 'h3') return <h3 key={i}>{inline(b.text)}</h3>
        if (b.type === 'ul') return <ul key={i}>{b.items.map((t, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(t)}</li>)}</ul>
        if (b.type === 'ol') return <ol key={i}>{b.items.map((t, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(t)}</li>)}</ol>
        return <p key={i}>{inline(b.text)}</p>
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * Split markdown into blocks.
 *
 * @param {string} src - Markdown text.
 * @returns {Array<object>} Blocks in document order.
 */
export function parseMarkdown(src) {
  // A local model often emits a whole list on one line: "1. Do this. 2. Then
  // that." Splitting only on newlines would render that as one paragraph, so
  // an obvious run of numbered or bulleted items mid-line is broken out first.
  const normalised = String(src)
    .replace(/\s+(\d+\.\s+)/g, '\n$1')
    .replace(/\s+([-*]\s+)(?=\S)/g, '\n$1')

  const lines = normalised.split('\n')
  const blocks = []
  let para = []
  let list = null

  const flushPara = () => { if (para.length) { blocks.push({ type: 'p', text: para.join(' ') }); para = [] } }
  const flushList = () => { if (list) { blocks.push(list); list = null } }

  for (const raw of lines) {
    const line = raw.trimEnd()
    if (!line.trim()) { flushPara(); flushList(); continue }

    const h = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/)
    if (h) {
      flushPara(); flushList()
      blocks.push({ type: h[1].length <= 2 ? 'h2' : 'h3', text: h[2] })
      continue
    }
    const ul = line.match(/^\s*[-*]\s+(.*)$/)
    if (ul) {
      flushPara()
      if (!list || list.type !== 'ul') { flushList(); list = { type: 'ul', items: [] } }
      list.items.push(ul[1])
      continue
    }
    const ol = line.match(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+(.*)$/)
    if (ol) {
      flushPara()
      if (!list || list.type !== 'ol') { flushList(); list = { type: 'ol', items: [] } }
      list.items.push(ol[1])
      continue
    }
    flushList()
    para.push(line.trim())
  }
  flushPara(); flushList()
  return blocks
}

/**
 * Render bold, inline code and bare URLs as React nodes — never as raw HTML.
 *
 * URLs are linked because a model that reports "Ticket KAV-5 raised.
 * https://…/browse/KAV-5" has given the user the one thing they want to click
 * on, and printing it as text makes them select and copy it by hand.
 *
 * @param {string} text - A line of markdown.
 * @returns {Array} React nodes.
 */
export function inline(text) {
  const parts = String(text).split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|https?:\/\/[^\s<>()]+)/g)
  return parts.map((p, i) => {
    if (!p) return null
    if (p.startsWith('**') && p.endsWith('**')) return <strong key={i}>{p.slice(2, -2)}</strong>
    if (p.startsWith('`') && p.endsWith('`')) return <code key={i}>{p.slice(1, -1)}</code>
    if (/^https?:\/\//.test(p)) {
      // Trailing punctuation belongs to the sentence, not the link.
      const m = p.match(/^(.*?)([.,;:)]*)$/)
      return (
        <span key={i}>
          <a href={m[1]} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{m[1]}</a>{m[2]}
        </span>
      )
    }
    return p
  })
}

'use client'

// components/ProgressStream/ProgressStream.jsx
// Renders live progress events from the backend SSE stream.
// Used during survey, generation, and execution phases.

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import styles from './ProgressStream.module.css'

export default function ProgressStream({ title, description, messages }) {
  const bottomRef = useRef(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })
  }, [messages])

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <div className={styles.spinner} aria-hidden="true" />
        <div>
          <h3 className={styles.title}>{title}</h3>
          <p className={styles.description}>{description}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.log} role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Progress log">
        {messages.length === 0 && (
          <div className={styles.logEmpty}>Starting…</div>
        )}
        {messages.map((msg, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={styles.logLine}>
            <span className={styles.logStep}>{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
            <span className={styles.logMsg}>{msg}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * components/Providers/Providers.jsx
 *
 * Client-side provider tree for the Kavach root layout.
 *
 * This is the only place MsalProvider appears in the application.
 * It receives the singleton PublicClientApplication from lib/msalInstance.js.
 *
 * On every mount, MsalProvider:
 *   1. Calls msalInstance.initialize() (required in @azure/msal-browser v3).
 *   2. Processes any Entra redirect response via handleRedirectPromise(),
 *      which runs inside initialize().  This completes the login flow when
 *      the browser returns from the Entra sign-in page.
 *   3. Emits auth events that the event callback in msalInstance.js uses
 *      to keep the active account in sync.
 *
 * AuthGuard is nested inside MsalProvider so it has access to the
 * initialised MSAL context when it decides whether to render children
 * or trigger a login redirect.
 */

import { MsalProvider } from '@azure/msal-react'
import { msalInstance } from '../../lib/msalInstance'
import AuthGuard from '../AuthGuard/AuthGuard'

export default function Providers({ children }) {
  return (
    <MsalProvider instance={msalInstance}>
      <AuthGuard>{children}</AuthGuard>
    </MsalProvider>
  )
}

'use client'

// components/ScenarioReview/ScenarioReview.jsx
// Two-pane (master-detail) review, resizable + collapsible.
//   LEFT  — filterable requirement list (drag the divider to resize, or use
//           the ‹ button to collapse it and give the detail the full width).
//   RIGHT — the selected requirement's test cases, with compact controls
//           (Replace · Automate · priority) and expandable steps.
// The component fills 100% of whatever width its parent gives it. If it still
// looks narrow, the parent page constrains it (see the CSS note that ships
// with this file — the .page max-width in new-test-suite.module.css).

import { useState, useRef } from 'react'
import styles from './ScenarioReview.module.css'

const PRIORITIES = [
  { value: 'P0', label: 'P0 — Blocker' },
  { value: 'P1', label: 'P1 — Critical' },
  { value: 'P2', label: 'P2 — High' },
  { value: 'P3', label: 'P3 — Medium' },
  { value: 'P4', label: 'P4 — Low' },
]

function defaultPriority(category) {
  if (category === 'negative' || category === 'security') return 'P1'
  if (category === 'boundary' || category === 'wrong_data') return 'P2'
  if (category === 'missing_field') return 'P3'
  return 'P2'
}

function groupRows(rows) {
  const map = new Map()
  for (const r of rows) {
    const name = r.scenario || (r.tags && r.tags.scenario) || 'General'
    const reqId = r.requirement_id || (r.tags && r.tags.requirement_id) || null
    if (!map.has(name)) map.set(name, { name, requirement_id: reqId, rows: [] })
    const g = map.get(name)
    if (!g.requirement_id && reqId) g.requirement_id = reqId
    g.rows.push(r)
  }
  return Array.from(map.values())
}

const CATEGORY_COLORS = {
  positive: { bg: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.14)',  fg: 'var(--green, #16a34a)' },
  negative: { bg: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.14)',  fg: 'var(--red, #dc2626)' },
  edge:     { bg: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.16)', fg: 'var(--amber, #d97706)' },
  boundary: { bg: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.16)', fg: 'var(--amber, #d97706)' },
  security: { bg: 'rgba(168,85,247,0.16)', fg: 'var(--purple-light, #9333ea)' },
}

function isNoMatch(r) {
  return Array.isArray(r.steps) && r.steps.some((s) => s.matched === false)
}

const FILTERS = [
  { key: 'all',      label: 'All' },
  { key: 'inferred', label: 'AI-inferred' },
  { key: 'neg',      label: 'Neg / edge' },
  { key: 'nomatch',  label: 'No UI match' },
]

function matchesFilter(r, f) {
  if (f === 'all') return true
  if (f === 'inferred') return r.derivation === 'inferred'
  if (f === 'neg') return ['negative', 'edge', 'boundary', 'security'].includes(r.category)
  if (f === 'nomatch') return isNoMatch(r)
  return true
}

function Badge({ children, bg, fg, title }) {
  return (
    <span title={title} style={{
      background: bg, color: fg, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
      padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 4, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
      textTransform: 'capitalize',
    }}>{children}</span>
  )
}

export default function ScenarioReview({ proposals, onConfirm }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState(
    proposals.map((p) => ({
      ...p, included: true, automate: true, replace: false,
      priority: p.priority || defaultPriority(p.category),
    }))
  )
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(() => new Set())
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all')
  const [selectedGroup, setSelectedGroup] = useState(null)

  // Resizable / collapsible left pane.
  const [navWidth, setNavWidth] = useState(288)
  const [navCollapsed, setNavCollapsed] = useState(false)
  const bodyRef = useRef(null)
  function startDrag(e) {
    e.preventDefault()
    const onMove = (ev) => {
      const rect = bodyRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
      if (!rect) return
      let w = ev.clientX - rect.left
      w = Math.max(200, Math.min(w, rect.width - 340))
      setNavWidth(w)
    }
    const onUp = () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove)
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp)
      document.body.style.userSelect = ''
    }
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none'
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove)
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp)
  }

  const allIncluded = rows.filter((r) => r.included)

  function toggleExpanded(id) {
    setExpanded((p) => { const n = new Set(p); n.has(id) ? n.delete(id) : n.add(id); return n })
  }
  function toggleIncluded(id) {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) =>
      r.id === id ? { ...r, included: !r.included, automate: !r.included ? r.automate : false } : r))
  }
  function toggleAutomate(id) {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => r.id === id ? { ...r, automate: !r.automate } : r))
  }
  function toggleReplace(id) {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => r.id === id ? { ...r, replace: !r.replace } : r))
  }
  function automateAll(on) {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => r.included ? { ...r, automate: on } : r))
  }
  function setPriority(id, priority) {
    setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => r.id === id ? { ...r, priority } : r))
  }
  function selectAll() { setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => ({ ...r, included: true }))) }
  function selectNone() { setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => ({ ...r, included: false }))) }
  function handleConfirm() {
    const approved = rows.filter((r) => r.included)
    if (approved.length === 0) return
    onConfirm(approved.map((r) => ({ ...r, on_duplicate: r.replace ? 'replace' : 'skip' })))
  }

  const filteredRows = rows.filter((r) => matchesFilter(r, filter))
  const groups = groupRows(filteredRows)
  const activeName =
    (selectedGroup && groups.some((g) => g.name === selectedGroup))
      ? selectedGroup : (groups[0] ? groups[0].name : null)
  const activeGroup = groups.find((g) => g.name === activeName) || null

  const totalReqs = groupRows(rows).length
  const totalTests = rows.length
  const inferredCount = rows.filter((r) => r.derivation === 'inferred').length
  const nomatchCount = rows.filter(isNoMatch).length

  return (
    <div className={styles.container} style={{ width: '100%' }}>
      {/* ── Top bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <div>
          <h3 className={styles.title}>Review generated scenarios</h3>
          <p className={styles.subtitle}>
            {totalReqs} requirement{totalReqs === 1 ? '' : 's'} · {totalTests} test case{totalTests === 1 ? '' : 's'}
            {inferredCount > 0 && <> · <span style={{ color: 'var(--amber)' }}>{inferredCount} AI-inferred</span></>}
            {nomatchCount > 0 && <> · {nomatchCount} no UI match</>}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.headerActions}>
          <button className="btn btn-ghost"
                  onClick={() => (allIncluded.length === rows.length ? selectNone() : selectAll())}>
            {allIncluded.length === rows.length ? 'Keep none' : 'Keep all'}
          </button>
          <button className="btn btn-ghost"
                  onClick={() => automateAll(rows.filter((r) => r.included && r.automate).length !== allIncluded.length)}>
            {rows.filter((r) => r.included && r.automate).length === allIncluded.length && allIncluded.length > 0
              ? 'Automate none' : 'Automate all'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Two-pane body ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className={styles.empty}>
          No scenarios were generated. Try providing a URL or a requirements document.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div ref={bodyRef} style={{ display: 'flex', height: '64vh', minHeight: 440, width: '100%' }}>

          {/* Collapsed rail: a thin bar with a show button */}
          {navCollapsed ? (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setNavCollapsed(false)} title="Show requirement list"
              style={{
                width: 30, flexShrink: 0, border: 'none', borderRight: '1px solid var(--border)',
                background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 16,
              }}>›</button>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* LEFT — filters + requirement list */}
              <div style={{
                width: navWidth, flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', minHeight: 0,
                background: 'var(--bg-subtle, rgba(120,120,140,0.04))',
                borderRight: '1px solid var(--border)',
              }}>
                <div style={{
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '10px 12px',
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 3, flex: 1 }}>
                    {FILTERS.map((f) => {
                      const active = filter === f.key
                      return (
                        <button key={f.key} type="button" onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)}
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 5, cursor: 'pointer',
                            transition: 'all .12s', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                            background: active ? 'var(--accent-glow, rgba(99,102,241,0.12))' : 'transparent',
                            color: active ? 'var(--accent, #6366f1)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                            border: `1px solid ${active ? 'var(--accent, #6366f1)' : 'transparent'}`,
                          }}>{f.label}</button>
                      )
                    })}
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setNavCollapsed(true)} title="Hide list"
                    style={{ border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer',
                      color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1, width: 20, height: 20,
                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      borderRadius: 5, padding: 0, flexShrink: 0 }}>‹</button>
                </div>

                <div style={{ overflowY: 'auto', flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
                  {groups.length === 0 ? (
                    <div style={{ padding: 18, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Nothing matches this filter.</div>
                  ) : groups.map((g) => {
                    const inf = g.rows.filter((r) => r.derivation === 'inferred').length
                    const active = g.name === activeName
                    return (
                      <button key={g.name} type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedGroup(g.name)}
                        style={{
                          display: 'block', width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', cursor: 'pointer',
                          padding: '11px 14px', border: 'none', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                          borderLeft: active ? '3px solid var(--accent, #6366f1)' : '3px solid transparent',
                          background: active ? 'var(--accent-glow, rgba(99,102,241,0.10))' : 'transparent',
                          transition: 'background .12s',
                        }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          {g.requirement_id && (
                            <span style={{
                              background: active ? 'var(--accent, #6366f1)' : 'var(--bg-accent, rgba(99,102,241,0.12))',
                              color: active ? '#fff' : 'var(--accent, #6366f1)',
                              fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flexShrink: 0,
                            }}>{g.requirement_id}</span>
                          )}
                          <span style={{
                            fontSize: 14, fontWeight: active ? 700 : 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                            overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                          }}>{g.name}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginTop: 3, fontSize: 11 }}>
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{g.rows.length} test{g.rows.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
                          {inf > 0 && <span style={{ color: 'var(--amber)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{inf} AI</span>}
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Drag handle */}
              <div onMouseDown={startDrag} title="Drag to resize"
                style={{
                  width: 6, flexShrink: 0, cursor: 'col-resize',
                  borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRight: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                }} />
            </>
          )}

          {/* RIGHT — detail */}
          <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', minHeight: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
            {!activeGroup ? (
              <div style={{ padding: 28, fontSize: 14, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Select a requirement on the left.</div>
            ) : (
              <div>
                <div style={{
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '14px 22px',
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)', position: 'sticky', top: 0,
                  background: 'var(--bg-card)', zIndex: 1,
                }}>
                  {activeGroup.requirement_id && (
                    <span style={{
                      background: 'var(--accent, #6366f1)', color: '#fff',
                      fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, padding: '3px 9px', borderRadius: 5, flexShrink: 0,
                    }}>{activeGroup.requirement_id}</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-primary)', letterSpacing: '-0.2px',
                    overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  }}>{activeGroup.name}</span>
                  <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-muted)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    {activeGroup.rows.length} test case{activeGroup.rows.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {activeGroup.rows.map((row) => {
                  const cat = CATEGORY_COLORS[row.category] || null
                  return (
                    <div key={row.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)', opacity: row.included ? 1 : 0.45 }}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12, padding: '12px 20px' }}>
                        <input type="checkbox" className={styles.checkbox} style={{ marginTop: 3, flexShrink: 0 }}
                          checked={row.included} onChange={() => toggleIncluded(row.id)}
                          aria-label={`Include: ${row.title}`} />

                        {/* title with an inline category label; provenance badge sits below */}
                        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                            <span style={{ fontSize: 14, color: 'var(--text-primary)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{row.title}</span>
                            {cat && (
                              <span style={{
                                fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: cat.fg,
                                border: `1px solid ${cat.bg}`, background: 'transparent',
                                padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, textTransform: 'capitalize',
                                flexShrink: 0, letterSpacing: 0,
                              }}>{row.category}</span>
                            )}
                            {row.derivation === 'inferred' && (
                              <span title="Reasoned by the AI — not stated in the requirement. Review it."
                                style={{
                                  fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--amber, #d97706)',
                                  border: '1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.35)', background: 'transparent',
                                  padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, flexShrink: 0, letterSpacing: 0,
                                }}>AI</span>
                            )}
                            {Array.isArray(row.steps) && row.steps.length > 0 && (
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => toggleExpanded(row.id)}
                                style={{
                                  background: 'none', border: 'none', padding: 0, marginLeft: 2,
                                  color: 'var(--text-dimmer)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 11,
                                  display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3, flexShrink: 0,
                                }}>
                                <span style={{ fontSize: 9 }}>{expanded.has(row.id) ? '▾' : '▸'}</span>
                                {row.steps.length} step{row.steps.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* compact controls, single row, never wraps */}
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                          {row.duplicate_of && (
                            <label title="Replace the existing test case, keeping its run history"
                              style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: 12,
                                color: row.replace ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--text-muted)', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                              <input type="checkbox" checked={!!row.replace} onChange={() => toggleReplace(row.id)}
                                style={{ accentColor: 'var(--amber)', width: 14, height: 14 }} />
                              Replace
                            </label>
                          )}
                          <label title="Generate a Selenium script for this test case now"
                            style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: 12,
                              color: row.included ? 'var(--text-secondary)' : 'var(--text-dimmer)',
                              cursor: row.included ? 'pointer' : 'default', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                            <input type="checkbox" checked={row.automate && row.included} disabled={!row.included}
                              onChange={() => toggleAutomate(row.id)} style={{ accentColor: 'var(--accent)', width: 14, height: 14 }} />
                            Automate
                          </label>
                          <select value={row.priority} onChange={(e) => setPriority(row.id, e.target.value)}
                            disabled={!row.included} title="Priority" aria-label={`Priority for: ${row.title}`}
                            style={{
                              background: 'var(--bg-input)', border: '1px solid var(--border-strong)',
                              borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontFamily: 'inherit',
                              fontSize: 12, padding: '5px 6px', cursor: 'pointer', width: 62,
                            }}>
                            {PRIORITIES.map((p) => (
                              <option key={p.value} value={p.value} title={p.label}>{p.value}</option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {expanded.has(row.id) && Array.isArray(row.steps) && row.steps.length > 0 && (
                        <div className={styles.stepTableWrap}>
                          <table className={styles.stepTable}>
                            <thead>
                              <tr>
                                <th scope="col">Step No</th>
                                <th scope="col">Step Description</th>
                                <th scope="col">Expected Result</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                              {row.steps.map((s, i) => (
                                <tr key={s.n ?? i}>
                                  <td className={styles.stepNumberCell}>{s.n ?? i + 1}</td>
                                  <td className={styles.stepDescriptionCell}>
                                    {s.step || '—'}
                                    {s.matched === false && (
                                      <span className={styles.stepUnmatched}>
                                        no matching UI element
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </td>
                                  <td className={styles.stepExpectedCell}>
                                    {s.expected || '—'}
                                  </td>
                                </tr>
                              ))}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <span className={styles.selectedCount}>
          {(() => {
            const keep = allIncluded.length
            const auto = rows.filter((r) => r.included && r.automate).length
            const drop = rows.length - keep
            const parts = [`${keep} saved as test case${keep === 1 ? '' : 's'}`]
            if (auto) parts.push(`${auto} scripted now`)
            if (keep - auto > 0) parts.push(`${keep - auto} to script later`)
            if (drop) parts.push(`${drop} discarded`)
            return parts.join(' · ')
          })()}
        </span>
        <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={allIncluded.length === 0}>
          <i className="ti ti-wand" aria-hidden="true" />
          {(() => {
            const keep = allIncluded.length
            const auto = rows.filter((r) => r.included && r.automate).length
            if (auto === 0) return `Save ${keep} test case${keep === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
            return `Save ${keep}, automate ${auto}`
          })()}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * components/ThemeToggle/ThemeToggle.jsx
 *
 * Light/dark switch. Sets data-theme on <html> and remembers the
 * choice in localStorage so it survives reloads. Defaults to dark.
 *
 * (This is a real Next.js app, not a sandboxed artifact — localStorage
 * is available and appropriate here.)
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import styles from './ThemeToggle.module.css'

export default function ThemeToggle() {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState('dark')

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('kavach-theme') : null
    const initial = saved || 'dark'
    setThemeState(initial)
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', initial)
  }, [])

  function setTheme(next) {
    setThemeState(next)
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next)
    try { localStorage.setItem('kavach-theme', next) } catch {}
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.toggle} role="group" aria-label="Theme">
      <button
        className={theme === 'light' ? styles.on : ''}
        onClick={() => setTheme('light')}
        aria-label="Light mode"
        title="Light mode"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
          <path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4 12H2M22 12h-2M6 6L4.5 4.5M19.5 19.5L18 18M6 18l-1.5 1.5M19.5 4.5L18 6" />
        </svg>
      </button>
      <button
        className={theme === 'dark' ? styles.on : ''}
        onClick={() => setTheme('dark')}
        aria-label="Dark mode"
        title="Dark mode"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
          <path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1111.2 3a7 7 0 009.8 9.8z" />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

/**
 * hooks/useAuth.js
 *
 * Shared authentication hook for Kavach.
 *
 * Must be used inside a component that is a descendant of MsalProvider
 * (i.e. inside the Providers wrapper in the root layout).
 *
 * Returns:
 *   isAuthenticated {boolean}
 *       true once the user has a valid Entra session.
 *
 *   user {AccountInfo|null}
 *       The signed-in user's MSAL account object.  Key fields:
 *         user.name     — display name (e.g. "Jane Doe")
 *         user.username — UPN / email (e.g. "jane@baxter.com")
 *       null when not authenticated.
 *
 *   login()  {async}
 *       Trigger Microsoft Entra login redirect.  MSAL stores the current
 *       page URL and returns to it after a successful sign-in.
 *
 *   logout() {async}
 *       Sign the user out and redirect to the post-logout URI.
 *
 *   getToken() {async → string|null}
 *       Acquire a Kavach backend access token silently from the cache or
 *       Entra's token endpoint.  If the cached token has expired and
 *       silent renewal fails, triggers a login redirect (the page reloads
 *       after sign-in and the caller should not expect a return value).
 *
 *       IMPORTANT: always await getToken().  Calling it without await is
 *       incorrect — the returned Promise must be resolved before the token
 *       string is available.
 */

import { useMsal, useIsAuthenticated } from '@azure/msal-react'
import { loginRequest } from '../lib/msalConfig'

export function useAuth() {
  const { instance, accounts } = useMsal()
  const isAuthenticated = useIsAuthenticated()

  // The first account in the list is the one MSAL set as active via the
  // event callback in msalInstance.js.  It is populated from sessionStorage
  // on every page load, so it survives refreshes.
  const user = accounts[0] ?? null

  /**
   * Trigger a Microsoft Entra login redirect.
   *
   * MSAL saves the current page URL before redirecting and navigates back
   * to it after a successful sign-in (navigateToLoginRequestUrl: true).
   */
  async function login() {
    await instance.loginRedirect(loginRequest)
  }

  /**
   * Sign the user out.
   *
   * The browser is redirected to NEXT_PUBLIC_MS_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI
   * after Entra completes the sign-out.
   */
  async function logout() {
    await instance.logoutRedirect({
      account: instance.getActiveAccount(),
    })
  }

  /**
   * Acquire an access token for the Kavach backend API.
   *
   * Attempts a silent acquisition first (no network round-trip if the token
   * is still cached).  If silent acquisition fails (expired token, empty
   * cache) a login redirect is triggered to re-establish the session.
   *
   * Always await this function.  The returned Promise resolves to the access
   * token string, or to null when a redirect was triggered (in which case
   * the browser navigates away and the calling component will remount after
   * sign-in completes).
   *
   * The scopes requested here include NEXT_PUBLIC_MS_AUTH_API_SCOPE so that
   * the returned token is valid for the Kavach backend, not Microsoft Graph.
   *
   * @returns {Promise<string|null>}
   */
  async function getToken() {
    const account = instance.getActiveAccount()
    if (!account) {
      throw new Error('getToken: no active account — the user must be authenticated first')
    }
    try {
      const response = await instance.acquireTokenSilent({
        ...loginRequest,
        account,
      })
      return response.accessToken
    } catch {
      // Silent acquisition failed.  Redirect to Entra to re-authenticate;
      // after sign-in the user returns to the current page.
      await instance.loginRedirect({
        ...loginRequest,
        account,
      })
      // The browser navigates away — this line is never reached.
      return null
    }
  }

  return { isAuthenticated, user, login, logout, getToken }
}

// hooks/useSSE.js
// Shared hook for consuming Server-Sent Events from the backend.
// Used by the new-test-suite flow and any other streaming endpoint.

import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react'
import { API_BASE, currentUserEmail } from '../lib/api'

/**
 * Returns a startStream function that opens an SSE connection to the
 * given path, calls onEvent for each event, and calls onDone when
 * the stream ends (on a 'complete' or 'error' event).
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const { startStream } = useSSE()
 *   await startStream('/v1/test-suites/survey', formData, onEvent, onDone)
 */
export function useSSE() {
  const abortRef = useRef(null)

  const startStream = useCallback(async (path, formData, onEvent, onDone) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort()
    const controller = new AbortController()
    abortRef.current = controller

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'X-Triggered-By': currentUserEmail() },
        body: formData,
        signal: controller.signal,
      })

      if (!response.ok) {
        onDone?.({ error: `Request failed: ${response.status}` })
        return
      }

      const reader = response.body.getReader()
      const decoder = new TextDecoder()
      let buffer = ''

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read()
        if (done) break

        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
        const chunks = buffer.split('\n\n')
        buffer = chunks.pop()

        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          if (!chunk.startsWith('data: ')) continue
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(chunk.slice(6))
            onEvent?.(payload)
            if (payload.type === 'complete' || payload.type === 'error') {
              onDone?.(payload.data)
              return
            }
          } catch {
            // Malformed SSE chunk — skip it
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
        onDone?.({ error: err.message })
      }
    }
  }, [])

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    abortRef.current?.abort()
  }, [])

  return { startStream, cancel }
}

FILE: frontend/hooks/useWorkflowCancellation.mjs
================================================
import { useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

export class WorkflowCancelledError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super('This workflow is stopping; no further work can start.')
    this.name = 'WorkflowCancelledError'
  }
}

/** Flow-scoped capability, held only in memory. This is not user authentication. */
export function createWorkflowCancellationController({
  apiBase,
  fetchImpl = (...args) => fetch(...args),
  schedule = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
  unschedule = id => clearTimeout(id),
  requestTimeoutMs = 15000,
  pollIntervalMs = 1000,
}) {
  let snapshot = { state: 'active', error: null }
  let flow = null
  let initialization = null // Keep even a rejected promise: never silently create another flow.
  let requested = false
  let live = true
  let pollTimer = null
  let attempt = null
  let epoch = 0
  const listeners = new Set()
  const controls = new Set()
  const transports = new Set()
  const readers = new Set()
  const responses = new WeakMap()

  const publish = patch => {
    snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch }
    if (live) listeners.forEach(listener => listener())
  }
  const isCancelled = () => requested || !live
  const assertActive = () => {
    if (isCancelled()) throw new WorkflowCancelledError()
  }
  const guard = callback => (...args) => {
    if (!isCancelled()) return callback(...args)
  }
  const clearPoll = () => {
    if (pollTimer !== null) unschedule(pollTimer)
    pollTimer = null
  }

  // Bound control requests, including reading their bodies. A timeout is never an acknowledgement.
  const controlJson = async (url, options = {}) => {
    const abort = new AbortController()
    let timer
    let stop
    const interrupted = new Promise((_, reject) => {
      stop = () => {
        abort.abort()
        reject(new Error('Cancellation confirmation unavailable.'))
      }
      timer = schedule(stop, requestTimeoutMs)
    })
    controls.add(stop)
    try {
      return await Promise.race([
        (async () => {
          const response = await fetchImpl(url, { ...options, signal: abort.signal, cache: 'no-store' })
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Workflow control request failed.')
          return response.json()
        })(),
        interrupted,
      ])
    } finally {
      unschedule(timer)
      controls.delete(stop)
    }
  }

  const initialize = () => {
    if (!initialization) {
      initialization = controlJson(`${apiBase}/v1/test-suites/flows`, { method: 'POST' })
        .then(data => {
          if (!data?.flow_id || !data?.control_key || data.state !== 'active' || data.active_operations !== 0) {
            throw new Error('Could not establish workflow tracking. No action was started.')
          }
          flow = { id: data.flow_id, key: data.control_key }
          return flow
        })
    }
    return initialization
  }

  const releaseResponse = response => {
    const transport = responses.get(response)
    if (transport) transports.delete(transport)
    responses.delete(response)
  }
  const trackReader = reader => {
    if (snapshot.state === 'cancelled') {
      Promise.resolve().then(() => reader.cancel()).catch(() => {})
      return () => {}
    }
    readers.add(reader)
    return () => readers.delete(reader)
  }

  const request = async (url, options = {}) => {
    assertActive()
    const current = await initialize()
    assertActive() // Cancellation during initialization must not launch the action.
    const headers = new Headers(options.headers)
    headers.set('X-Workflow-Id', current.id)
    headers.set('X-Workflow-Key', current.key)
    const transport = new AbortController()
    transports.add(transport)
    try {
      // Do not forward caller abort signals: stopping a connection is not stopping server work.
      const response = await fetchImpl(url, { ...options, headers, signal: transport.signal })
      assertActive()
      const wrapped = new Proxy(response, {
        get(target, property) {
          if (['json', 'text', 'blob', 'arrayBuffer', 'formData'].includes(property)) {
            return async (...args) => {
              try {
                const result = await target[property](...args)
                assertActive() // Suppress late JSON results as well as late SSE callbacks.
                return result
              } finally {
                releaseResponse(wrapped)
              }
            }
          }
          const value = Reflect.get(target, property, target)
          return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(target) : value
        },
      })
      responses.set(wrapped, transport)
      return wrapped
    } catch (error) {
      // Keep late response transports until backend acknowledgement, not merely until fetch resolves.
      if (!requested) transports.delete(transport)
      throw error
    }
  }

  const confirmed = () => {
    clearPoll()
    // Only this backend-confirmed path may close active work transports/readers.
    transports.forEach(transport => transport.abort())
    transports.clear()
    readers.forEach(reader => { Promise.resolve().then(() => reader.cancel()).catch(() => {}) })
    readers.clear()
    publish({ state: 'cancelled', error: null })
  }

  const runAttempt = (sendCancel) => {
    if (attempt) return attempt
    const currentEpoch = epoch
    const work = async () => {
      try {
        if (!initialization) {
          // Only a never-started, local configuration can exit without a server acknowledgement.
          confirmed()
          return
        }
        await initialization
        if (!live || currentEpoch !== epoch) return
        const data = await controlJson(
          `${apiBase}/v1/test-suites/flows/${encodeURIComponent(flow.id)}${sendCancel ? '/cancel' : ''}`,
          { method: sendCancel ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: { 'X-Workflow-Key': flow.key } },
        )
        if (!live || currentEpoch !== epoch) return
        if (data?.state === 'cancelled' && data.active_operations === 0) {
          confirmed()
        } else if (data?.state === 'cancelling' && Number.isInteger(data.active_operations) && data.active_operations >= 0) {
          publish({ state: 'cancelling', error: null })
          pollTimer = schedule(() => {
            pollTimer = null
            if (live && snapshot.state === 'cancelling') void runAttempt(false)
          }, pollIntervalMs)
        } else {
          throw new Error('Cleanup is not confirmed.')
        }
      } catch {
        if (live && currentEpoch === epoch) {
          publish({
            state: 'cancelling',
            error: 'Stopping and cleanup are not confirmed. Retry confirmation. If the server restarted or the flow expired, confirmation may be unavailable; do not assume the work stopped.',
          })
        }
      }
    }
    // Defer work so repeated calls always share the same attempt, including the local exit path.
    attempt = Promise.resolve().then(work).finally(() => {
      if (currentEpoch === epoch) attempt = null
    })
    return attempt
  }

  const cancel = () => {
    if (requested) return attempt || Promise.resolve()
    requested = true // Synchronous fence, before React renders or any await.
    publish({ state: 'cancelling', error: null })
    return runAttempt(true)
  }
  const retry = () => {
    if (!requested || snapshot.state === 'cancelled' || !live) return Promise.resolve()
    clearPoll()
    publish({ state: 'cancelling', error: null })
    return runAttempt(true)
  }
  const deactivate = () => {
    live = false
    epoch += 1
    clearPoll()
    controls.forEach(stop => stop())
    controls.clear()
    attempt = null
    // Never auto-cancel server work or abort its streams on navigation/unmount.
  }
  const activate = () => {
    live = true
    if (requested && snapshot.state === 'cancelling' && !snapshot.error) void runAttempt(true)
  }

  return {
    request, cancel, retry, isCancelled, guard, releaseResponse, trackReader, activate, deactivate,
    getSnapshot: () => snapshot,
    subscribe: listener => { listeners.add(listener); return () => listeners.delete(listener) },
  }
}

export default function useWorkflowCancellation(apiBase) {
  // API base is fixed for this mounted wizard; controller methods retain stable identities.
  const [controller] = useState(() => createWorkflowCancellationController({ apiBase }))
  const status = useSyncExternalStore(controller.subscribe, controller.getSnapshot, controller.getSnapshot)
  useEffect(() => {
    controller.activate()
    return controller.deactivate
  }, [controller])
  return { ...controller, ...status }
}

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { createWorkflowCancellationController, WorkflowCancelledError } from './useWorkflowCancellation.mjs'

const deferred = () => {
  let resolve, reject
  const promise = new Promise((yes, no) => { resolve = yes; reject = no })
  return { promise, resolve, reject }
}
const json = (body, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status })
const created = (id = 'flow-a') => json({ flow_id: id, control_key: `key-${id}`, state: 'active', active_operations: 0 })
const stopping = count => json({ state: 'cancelling', active_operations: count })
const stopped = () => json({ state: 'cancelled', active_operations: 0 })
const settle = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) await Promise.resolve() }

function harness(fetcher) {
  let nextId = 0
  const timers = new Map()
  const calls = []
  const controller = createWorkflowCancellationController({
    apiBase: '',
    fetchImpl: (url, options) => {
      calls.push({ url, options })
      return fetcher(url, options)
    },
    schedule: (callback, ms) => {
      const id = ++nextId
      timers.set(id, { callback, ms })
      return id
    },
    unschedule: id => timers.delete(id),
    requestTimeoutMs: 50,
    pollIntervalMs: 10,
  })
  const tick = async ms => {
    for (const [id, timer] of [...timers]) {
      if (timer.ms === ms) {
        timers.delete(id)
        timer.callback()
      }
    }
    await settle()
  }
  return { controller, calls, timers, tick }
}

test('idle configuration exits locally without creating a flow', async () => {
  const { controller, calls, timers } = harness(() => { throw new Error('Unexpected request') })
  const result = controller.cancel()
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelling')
  assert.equal(controller.isCancelled(), true)
  await result
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelled')
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0)
  assert.equal(timers.size, 0)
  await assert.rejects(controller.request('/action'), WorkflowCancelledError)
})

test('concurrent first requests create exactly one flow and share its capability', async () => {
  const initialization = deferred()
  const { controller, calls } = harness(url => url.endsWith('/flows') ? initialization.promise : json({ ok: true }))
  const first = controller.request('/action-a', { headers: { 'X-Triggered-By': 'test' } })
  const second = controller.request('/action-b')
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1)
  initialization.resolve(created())
  await Promise.all([first, second])
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3)
  for (const call of calls.slice(1)) {
    assert.equal(call.options.headers.get('X-Workflow-Id'), 'flow-a')
    assert.equal(call.options.headers.get('X-Workflow-Key'), 'key-flow-a')
    assert.ok(!call.url.includes('key-flow-a'))
  }
  assert.equal(calls[1].options.headers.get('X-Triggered-By'), 'test')
})

test('cancellation during initialization waits for identity and never launches either action', async () => {
  const initialization = deferred()
  const { controller, calls } = harness(url => url.endsWith('/flows') ? initialization.promise : stopped())
  const first = assert.rejects(controller.request('/action-a'), WorkflowCancelledError)
  const second = assert.rejects(controller.request('/action-b'), WorkflowCancelledError)
  const cancellation = controller.cancel()
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelling')
  initialization.resolve(created())
  await Promise.all([first, second, cancellation])
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map(call => call.url), ['/v1/test-suites/flows', '/v1/test-suites/flows/flow-a/cancel'])
  assert.equal(calls[1].options.headers['X-Workflow-Key'], 'key-flow-a')
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelled')
})

test('repeated cancellation shares one attempt and cannot start new work', async () => {
  const acknowledgement = deferred()
  const { controller, calls } = harness(url =>
    url.endsWith('/flows') ? created() : url.endsWith('/cancel') ? acknowledgement.promise : json({}))
  await controller.request('/action')
  const first = controller.cancel()
  const second = controller.cancel()
  assert.equal(first, second)
  await assert.rejects(controller.request('/next-action'), WorkflowCancelledError)
  acknowledgement.resolve(stopped())
  await first
  await controller.cancel()
  assert.equal(calls.filter(call => call.url.endsWith('/cancel')).length, 1)
})

test('all response streams remain open until cancelled AND zero active operations', async () => {
  let statusCount = 0
  const { controller, calls, tick, timers } = harness(url => {
    if (url.endsWith('/flows')) return created()
    if (url.endsWith('/cancel')) return stopping(2)
    if (url.includes('/flows/')) return ++statusCount === 1 ? stopping(0) : stopped()
    return new Response('data: {}\n\n')
  })
  await Promise.all([controller.request('/action-a'), controller.request('/action-b')])
  let closed = 0
  controller.trackReader({ cancel: () => { closed++ } })
  controller.trackReader({ cancel: () => { closed++ } })
  const signals = calls.slice(1).map(call => call.options.signal)
  await controller.cancel()
  assert.equal(closed, 0)
  assert.ok(signals.every(signal => !signal.aborted))
  await tick(10)
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelling')
  assert.equal(closed, 0)
  assert.ok(signals.every(signal => !signal.aborted))
  await tick(10)
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelled')
  assert.equal(closed, 2)
  assert.ok(signals.every(signal => signal.aborted))
  assert.equal(timers.size, 0)
})

test('cancel is sent before pending action transport abort; late fetch cannot continue work', async () => {
  const action = deferred()
  let actionSignal
  const { controller, calls } = harness((url, options) => {
    if (url.endsWith('/flows')) return created()
    if (url.endsWith('/cancel')) {
      assert.equal(actionSignal.aborted, false)
      return stopped()
    }
    actionSignal = options.signal
    return action.promise
  })
  const pending = assert.rejects(controller.request('/action'), WorkflowCancelledError)
  await settle()
  await controller.cancel()
  assert.equal(actionSignal.aborted, true)
  action.resolve(json({}))
  await pending
  await assert.rejects(controller.request('/next-action'), WorkflowCancelledError)
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3)
})

test('late JSON acceptance cannot launch generation, and guarded callbacks are suppressed', async () => {
  const body = deferred()
  const { controller, calls } = harness(url => {
    if (url.endsWith('/flows')) return created()
    if (url.endsWith('/cancel')) return stopped()
    return { ok: true, json: () => body.promise }
  })
  let callbackCount = 0
  const callback = controller.guard(() => callbackCount++)
  callback()
  const workflow = (async () => {
    const response = await controller.request('/first-action')
    await response.json()
    return controller.request('/next-action')
  })()
  const rejected = assert.rejects(workflow, WorkflowCancelledError)
  await settle()
  await controller.cancel()
  callback()
  body.resolve({ ok: true })
  await rejected
  assert.equal(callbackCount, 1)
  assert.ok(!calls.some(call => call.url === '/next-action'))
})

for (const [label, response] of [
  ['unknown flow', () => json({}, 404)],
  ['expired flow', () => json({}, 410)],
  ['server error', () => json({}, 500)],
  ['lost connection', () => Promise.reject(new Error('disconnected'))],
  ['cleanup failed', () => json({ state: 'cleanup_failed', active_operations: 0 })],
  ['cancelled with active work', () => json({ state: 'cancelled', active_operations: 1 })],
  ['missing active count', () => json({ state: 'cancelled' })],

  ['unknown state', () => json({ state: 'missing', active_operations: 0 })],

  })
}

  assert.equal(calls[1].options.signal.aborted, false)

  controller.subscribe(() => notifications++)
  const cancellation = controller.cancel()
  await settle()
  controller.deactivate()
  await cancellation
  assert.equal(timers.size, 0)
  assert.equal(notifications, 1)
  pending.resolve(stopped())
  await settle()
  assert.equal(controller.getSnapshot().state, 'cancelling')
})

// lib/api.js
// The ONLY file that talks to the backend. Every component/page calls
// functions from here — never fetches directly.
//
// The backend base URL comes from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (set in
// .env.local). Falls back to localhost:9090 to match the backend's
// default dev port.

import { readGenerationResult } from './generationStream.mjs'
import { msalInstance } from './msalInstance'

export const API_BASE =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:9090'

/**
 * Return the signed-in user's email (or 'anonymous' if MSAL isn't ready
 * or nobody is signed in). Used by apiFetch to stamp the identity header
 * on every backend call so the backend can attribute actions and enforce
 * ownership-based visibility (e.g. per-user test data).
 */
export function currentUserEmail() {
  try {
    const active = msalInstance?.getActiveAccount()
    if (active?.username) return active.username
    // After a plain page refresh MSAL restores the signed-in account into
    // its cache but does NOT re-fire a LOGIN event, so getActiveAccount()
    // can be null even though the user is signed in. Fall back to the first
    // cached account and promote it to active so every later call — and the
    // X-Triggered-By header that per-user credentials depend on — stays
    // consistent instead of silently degrading to 'anonymous'.
    const all = msalInstance?.getAllAccounts?.() || []
    if (all.length > 0) {
      msalInstance.setActiveAccount(all[0])
      return all[0].username || 'anonymous'
    }
    return 'anonymous'
  } catch {
    return 'anonymous'
  }
}

/**
 * Core fetch wrapper. Adds JSON + identity headers and converts any
 * non-2xx response into a thrown Error carrying the backend's message.
 *
 * @param {string} path - API path, e.g. '/v1/applications'
 * @param {object} opts - standard fetch options
 * @returns {Promise<any>} parsed JSON body
 */
async function apiFetch(path, opts = {}, fetcher = fetch) {
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-Triggered-By': currentUserEmail(),
    ...(opts.headers || {}),
  }
  const response = await fetcher(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...opts, headers })
  if (!response.ok) {
    let message = `Request failed: ${response.status}`
    try {
      const body = await response.json()
      message = body?.error?.message || body?.detail || message
    } catch {
      /* body wasn't JSON */
    }
    throw new Error(message)
  }
  // 204 No Content
  if (response.status === 204) return null
  return response.json()
}

/**
 * Start an App Map crawl for an application.
 * Returns a raw fetch Response — the caller reads it as an SSE stream.
 * Use the useSSE hook or read response.body directly.
 *
 * @param {number} applicationId
 * @param {{ username?: string, password?: string, maxPages?: number }} opts
 */
export function crawlApplication(applicationId, opts = {}) {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('max_pages', String(opts.maxPages || 30))
  if (opts.username) body.append('username', opts.username)
  if (opts.password) body.append('password', opts.password)
  return fetch(`${API_BASE}/v1/applications/${applicationId}/crawl`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-Triggered-By': currentUserEmail() },
    body,
  })
}

 * Throws if no map has been crawled yet.

  return apiFetch(`/v1/applications/${applicationId}/maps/latest`)
}

/**
 * Reveal one masked field's real value.
 *
 * @param {object} opts
 * @param {number} opts.applicationId
 * @param {string} [opts.environment]
 * @param {string} opts.key - Field name, e.g. "password".
 * @param {string} [opts.persona] - When set, reveal
 *   environments.<env>.personas.<persona>.<key> instead of a flat
 *   top-level field (e.g. persona="approver", key="password") — see
 *   test_data/applications/app_<id>.json's "personas" block, used for
 *   multi-actor procedures (requester/approver/admin/... all within one
 *   continuous script run). Omitted (the default) is the existing
 *   flat-field behaviour, unchanged.
 */
export function revealAppTestDataField({ applicationId, environment, key, persona }) {
  return apiFetch('/v1/test-data/app/reveal', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      application_id: applicationId,
      environment,
      key,
      ...(persona ? { persona } : {}),
    }),
  })
}

// ─── My application login (per-user credentials) ─────────────────────────
//
// Each signed-in user stores THEIR OWN login for an application. The backend
// scopes every one of these calls to the caller (via the identity header
// apiFetch already sends), so a user only ever sees or changes their own
// credential — never anyone else's.

/**
 * Get the caller's saved login for an application. The password comes back
 * masked ("********") if one is stored; use revealMyAppCredential to see it.
 */
export function getMyAppCredential(applicationId) {
  return apiFetch(`/v1/app-credentials/${applicationId}`)
}

/**
 * Save (or replace) the caller's login for an application. Pass the masked
 * placeholder (or leave the password empty) to keep the stored password and
 * only update the username.
 */
export function saveMyAppCredential(applicationId, { username, password }) {
  return apiFetch(`/v1/app-credentials/${applicationId}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
  })
}

/** Reveal the caller's OWN password in plaintext for this application. */
export function revealMyAppCredential(applicationId) {
  return apiFetch(`/v1/app-credentials/${applicationId}/reveal`, { method: 'POST' })
}

/** Delete the caller's login for this application. */
export function deleteMyAppCredential(applicationId) {
  return apiFetch(`/v1/app-credentials/${applicationId}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
}

/**
 * Link (or unlink) a scenario-level test data file to one test case.
 *
 * Backs PATCH /v1/proposals/{id}/test-data-file (api/routes/run.py). This
 * only records WHICH file a scenario should read at generate/execute/run
 * time (test_case_proposals.tags.test_data_file) — it does not create or
 * modify the file's contents. Use saveScenarioTestData() for that, and
 * save the file BEFORE calling this, so a scenario is never linked to a
 * file that does not yet contain what the reviewer intended.
 *
 * @param {number} proposalId - The scenario (test case) to link.
 * @param {string|null} testDataFile - Filename under test_data/scenarios/
 *   (e.g. "item_2.json"), or null/empty to detach — the scenario then
 *   falls back to application-level test data only.
 */
export function setProposalTestDataFile(proposalId, testDataFile) {
  return apiFetch(`/v1/proposals/${proposalId}/test-data-file`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: JSON.stringify({ test_data_file: testDataFile || null }),
  })
}

// ─── Dashboards (real data) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Engineer/Subscriber dashboard.
 *
 * Called with no arguments for the page's main load (unchanged from
 * before). The Execution Trend / Results Distribution panels additionally
 * pass rangeDays/testType/applicationId to re-scope just those two
 * charts — everything else in the payload (KPIs, failing tests, recent
 * runs) is unaffected by these params on the backend, so passing them
 * never changes any other card on the page.
 *
 * @param {object} [params]
 * @param {number} [params.rangeDays] - How many days back to look (e.g.
 *   7, 14, 30, 56, 90). Omitted from the request entirely when not passed.
 * @param {string} [params.testType] - Restrict to one test type
 *   ('functional' | 'regression' | 'smoke'). 'all' means "no filter" and
 *   is not sent, matching how the rest of this file treats empty filters.
 * @param {string|number} [params.applicationId] - Restrict to one
 *   application's id. 'all' (or omitted) means "no filter" and is not
 *   sent — same convention as testType above.
 * @param {number} [params.failingLimit] - How many Failing Tests rows to
 *   return. Omitted = the backend's default (~12, matching the dashboard
 *   card). Pass a higher number (e.g. for the "More" modal) to get the
 *   full list.
 * @param {number} [params.recentLimit] - Same idea as failingLimit, for
 *   Recent Runs (backend default ~10).
 */
export function getEngineerDashboard({ rangeDays, testType, applicationId, failingLimit, recentLimit } = {}) {
  const q = new URLSearchParams()
  if (rangeDays !== undefined && rangeDays !== null && rangeDays !== '') {
    q.set('range_days', String(rangeDays))
  }
  if (testType && testType !== 'all') {
    q.set('test_type', testType)
  }
  if (applicationId !== undefined && applicationId !== null && applicationId !== 'all' && applicationId !== '') {
    q.set('application_id', String(applicationId))
  }
  if (failingLimit !== undefined && failingLimit !== null && failingLimit !== '') {
    q.set('failing_limit', String(failingLimit))
  }
  if (recentLimit !== undefined && recentLimit !== null && recentLimit !== '') {
    q.set('recent_limit', String(recentLimit))
  }
  const suffix = q.toString() ? `?${q.toString()}` : ''
  return apiFetch(`/v1/dashboard/engineer${suffix}`)
}

/**
 * Leadership dashboard.
 *
 * Called with no arguments for the page's main load (unchanged from
 * before). The Quality Trend / Automated Scripts by Application panels
 * additionally pass rangeDays/testType/applicationId to re-scope just
 * those two charts — same convention as getEngineerDashboard above, and
 * everything else in the payload (KPIs, coverage_by_app, risks) is
 * unaffected by these params on the backend.
 *
 * Note: rangeDays only affects Quality Trend. Automated Scripts by
 * Application is a snapshot of the current automation estate per
 * application (not an execution trend), so it only responds to
 * testType/applicationId — see dashboard.py for why.
 *
 * @param {object} [params]
 * @param {number} [params.rangeDays] - How many days back to look for
 *   Quality Trend. Omitted from the request entirely when not passed.
 * @param {string} [params.testType] - Restrict to one test type
 *   ('functional' | 'regression' | 'smoke'). 'all' means "no filter".
 * @param {string|number} [params.applicationId] - Restrict to one
 *   application's id. 'all' (or omitted) means "no filter".
 */
export function getLeadershipDashboard({ rangeDays, testType, applicationId } = {}) {
  const q = new URLSearchParams()
  if (rangeDays !== undefined && rangeDays !== null && rangeDays !== '') {
    q.set('range_days', String(rangeDays))
  }
  if (testType && testType !== 'all') {
    q.set('test_type', testType)
  }
  if (applicationId !== undefined && applicationId !== null && applicationId !== 'all' && applicationId !== '') {
    q.set('application_id', String(applicationId))
  }
  const suffix = q.toString() ? `?${q.toString()}` : ''
  return apiFetch(`/v1/dashboard/leadership${suffix}`)
}

/**
 * Token usage and cost per AI activity, for the dashboard's Tokens & Cost card.
 * applicationId 'all' (or empty) means no application filter.
 */

export async function generateScriptsFor(applicationId, proposalIds, options = {}) {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('application_id', applicationId)
  body.append('proposal_ids', proposalIds.join(','))
  body.append('environment_key', 'default')
  if (options.replaceExisting === true) body.append('replace_existing', 'true')
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/v1/test-suites/generate`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-Triggered-By': currentUserEmail() },
    body,
  })
  return readGenerationResult(response)
}

/**
 * Who the backend should attribute this request to.
 *
 * Kavach has no authentication yet, so this reads a name the user has set
 * locally and falls back to 'anonymous' — exactly what the backend already
 * defaults to. It is not a security control and does not pretend to be one:
 * anyone can set it. What it does give is a training record and an audit
 * trail that say something more useful than "anonymous" for every entry,
 * and one place to change when SSO arrives.
 *
 * @returns {string} The current user's name.
 */
export function getCurrentUser() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'anonymous'
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem('kavach-user') || 'anonymous'
  } catch {
    return 'anonymous'
  }
}

/**
 * Set the name requests are attributed to.
 *
 * @param {string} name - The user's name, or empty to clear it.
 */
export function setCurrentUser(name) {
  try {
    if (name) localStorage.setItem('kavach-user', name)
    else localStorage.removeItem('kavach-user')
  } catch {
    /* storage disabled — requests fall back to 'anonymous' */
  }
}

/**
 * Upload a training document.
 *
 * Bypasses apiFetch because that wrapper sets a JSON content type, which
 * would break the multipart boundary. Same approach as importPreview.
 *
 * @param {File} file - The PDF, DOCX or text file.
 * @param {string} [title] - Display name; defaults to the filename.
 */
export function uploadTrainingDocument(file, title) {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('file', file)
  if (title) body.append('title', title)
  return fetch(`${API_BASE}/v1/help/training`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-Triggered-By': getCurrentUser() },
    body,
  }).then(async r => {
    const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}))
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data?.detail || `Upload failed: ${r.status}`)
    return data
  })
}

 *
 * @param {object} opts
 * @param {string} [opts.raisedBy] - Restrict to one person.

 */
export function getSupportTickets({ raisedBy, limit = 50 } = {}) {
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) })
  if (raisedBy) q.set('raised_by', raisedBy)
  return apiFetch(`/v1/support/tickets?${q.toString()}`)
}

/**
 * Raise a support ticket.
 *
 * The response always carries the ticket, even when the external system
 * could not be reached — in that case it also carries an `error` and its
 * status is 'failed'. Callers should show both rather than treating the
 * error as a lost submission: the ticket exists in Kavach either way.
 *
 * @param {object} ticket
 * @param {string} ticket.category - One of getSupportCategories().
 * @param {string} ticket.summary - One-line title.
 * @param {string} [ticket.description] - The user's account of the problem.
 * @param {object} [ticket.context] - Technical detail captured automatically.
 */
export function raiseSupportTicket({ category, summary, description, context }) {
  return apiFetch('/v1/support/tickets', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      category,
      summary,
      description: description || '',
      context: context || {},
    }),
  })
}

/**
 * Collect the technical context worth attaching to a ticket.
 *
 * Gathered here rather than asked for, because a user reporting a problem
 * should not have to know what a generation id is, and a ticket without this
 * detail costs a round trip before anyone can start on it.
 *
 * @param {object} extra - Anything the calling screen knows, e.g.
 *   application_id or execution_id.
 * @returns {object} Context to send with the ticket.
 */
export function collectSupportContext(extra = {}) {
  const ctx = { ...extra }
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    ctx.route = window.location.pathname
    ctx.browser = navigator.userAgent
    ctx.viewport = `${window.innerWidth}x${window.innerHeight}`
  }
  ctx.raised_at = new Date().toISOString()
  return ctx
}

FILE: frontend/lib/generationStream.mjs
